name: s81ph-dsfd_capt_x-6fe9f807d-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): s81ph-dsfd_capt_x-6fe9f807d re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: capt_x with the LAG 1 ratio CDC (mem -> sh stable-data path)

bench.name: exact_cap_tiled
bench.cmd: bash tools/s81_ph/capt_bench.sh {RUN}/bench t1 'mix mix11 mix12 mix13 trace err over range rreq' S81PH_CAP_SAFE

calibrate.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; HM=0.035 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv' SDCX='physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/ser_clock_capt.sdc physical/s81_ph_views/capture/capt_x_lag.sdc' PRECTS=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pre_cts_ser_balance.tcl POSTCTS=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/post_cts_ser_vclk2.tcl CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_capt_x rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_cap_tile.sv $CL_STOP_AFTER

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; SDCM=physical/s81_ph_views/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN}.sdc HM=0.035 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/common/ot_ratio_cdc_fifo.sv' SDCX='physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/ser_clock_capt.sdc physical/s81_ph_views/capture/capt_x_lag.sdc' PRECTS=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pre_cts_ser_balance.tcl POSTCTS=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/post_cts_ser_vclk2.tcl CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_capt_x rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_cap_tile.sv $CL_STOP_AFTER

budget.reason: S81-PH tile sheet is grade 'target' (no calibration: ~600 ps); dsfd_capt_ctl measured 256 ps SS / 181 ps FF at calibrate (r1/r2), so the sheet SDC would place vclk ~350 ps late (output hold model -> mass hold buffering). Routed on the calibrated MEASURED insertion (STANDARD FLOW); calib.json is in the record for the sheet re-plan.
